svg.title: A 3D convolutional clause slides through a volume
svg.desc: A volume of five slices is searched by a three by three by three window that moves along columns, rows and depth. The clause looks for a plus, a dot and a plus on three consecutive slices. Its matches form one map per depth offset; since it is found at one position, the clause is true for the whole volume.
svg.text: the window covers 3 slices and moves along x, y and depth
